name: imagemagick
description: Image manipulation via ImageMagick CLI — resize, convert, composite, annotate, effects, and batch processing.

imagemagick.note: winget installs exactly the pin; brew/apt install their current version. The check accepts the pin or newer so it never forces a downgrade.

install.check: v=$(magick --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 | awk '{print $3}' | tr - .) && [ -n "$v" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n' '{{PIN:imagemagick}}' "$v" | sort -V | head -1)" = '{{PIN:imagemagick}}' ]
install.notes: ImageMagick 7+ uses the unified 'magick' command. Legacy v6 uses separate 'convert', 'identify', etc.

integration_test.description: Creates a test image and identifies it to verify full pipeline works
